title: An Idea Becomes a Connected System — Retrofuturism (1962 Idea Engine)

scenes.title: Power on
scenes.purpose: The idea ignites: a 1962 atomic-age engine assembles on a dark observatory stage while the title plate starts printing.
visuals: Three.js copper nucleus scales up with a warm halo and point light
Eight cream rays extend from the nucleus
Three cream orbit rings swing from face-on into their gimbal tilt, one after another, with copper and teal electrons travelling into place
SVG instrument plate wipes in 'MODEL 1962 · IDEA ENGINE', 'An Idea' and 'Becomes a'

beats.development: The nucleus powers on and the rays extend; the first ring starts to swing; the model label starts stepping in.
The second and third rings complete the atom; 'An Idea' and 'Becomes a' wipe in.

scenes.title: Connection
scenes.purpose: The idea becomes a connected system: emissive wiring runs from the atom into the control console, which responds.
visuals: Teal feed cable draws in from the left into the console
Three cream emissive wires draw from the electrons to the toggles, gauge and lamp
A single signal pulse travels along every wire once
Toggles flip up, the gauge arc draws, the needle swings with overshoot, the indicator lamp lights copper
'Connected System', the copper rules and the tagline complete the plate

beats.development: Wires and cable finish drawing; toggles flip in sequence; 'Connected System', the rules and the tagline land.
captions: Atomic-age wiring for the world of tomorrow

beats.development: The signal pulse runs the wires, the gauge arc draws, the needle swings and the lamp lights.

scenes.title: Settled system
scenes.purpose: Hold the complete, readable apparatus and copy.
visuals: Static complete scene: atom, wiring, live console and full title plate

beats.development: Nothing moves; the full composition is readable.
captions: Atomic-age wiring for the world of tomorrow

findings: All copy is fully revealed by 1.85s and all motion has settled by about 2.45s, inside the 2.7s requirement.
The 3-second preview is short, so the closing reading hold is only 0.55s; the copy is readable earlier as it lands.
justifiedHolds: 2.45–3.0s settled hold so the complete scene can be read and compared.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.
Camera holds still throughout, following the source lesson that state changes should read against a steady view.
Background and environment (wall, dome arcs, floor band, hatched disc, warm practical glow) are a stationary baked canvas texture.
